title: The Bleeding Altar
text: A stone altar weeps fresh blood. Carved into it: a die with a single eye. It wants to be fed.

options.label: Feed it (one hero loses 6 HP). Carve a die.
Walk away.

title: A Hanged Man's Purse
text: A body sways from an oak. A fat purse hangs from his belt. His fingers twitch.

options.label: Cut him down and take the purse.
Leave the dead in peace.

title: The Pilgrim's Fire
text: An old pilgrim with no eyes tends a small fire. "Sit," she says. "Or ask, and I will read your dice."

options.label: Rest by the fire (all heroes heal 6).
Ask for a reading (+3 Fate).

title: The Whispering Die
text: A black die lies in the mud, whispering your name. It is warm.

options.label: Roll it. (50%: carve a die and +2 Fate. 50%: a hero loses 8 HP.)
Bury it (+1 Fate).

title: The Ossuary Merchant
text: A smiling man in a coat of finger bones. "I buy what you won't miss. A little life, for a lot of gold."

options.label: Sell life (a hero loses 3 max HP) for 50 gold.
Refuse.

title: The Drowned Bell
text: A church bell rises from a black pond. Its rope is wet and cold.

options.label: Ring it (all heroes lose 3 HP, +5 Fate).
Do not wake what sleeps below.

title: Crow Feast
text: Crows tear at a fallen soldier. Something bigger moves behind them.

options.label: Chase them off (fight).
Search the body quickly (+12 gold, a hero loses 3 HP).

title: The Confessor
text: A priest without a face sits in a ruined booth. "Confess, and be made whole. The church accepts donations."

options.label: Confess and donate 20 gold (all heal 10, revive the fallen).
You have nothing to confess.

title: Cracked Shrine of Fate
text: Six stone faces, five of them broken. The last one still smiles.

options.label: Pray (all heroes lose 2 max HP). Carve a die.
Steal the offerings (+20 gold).

title: The Wounded Knight
text: A knight bleeds against a milestone. "Take my blade's secret," he gasps, "if you end my pain."

options.label: Grant him mercy. Carve a die.
Bandage him (-10 gold, +2 Fate).

title: The Weeping Statue
text: A stone saint cries real tears into a bowl. The water is warm and smells of iron.

options.label: Drink (all heroes heal 8, one hero loses 3 max HP).
Fill a flask for later (+2 Fate).

title: The Gravedigger's Bet
text: "Double or nothing," grins a man leaning on a spade. "Your gold against my grave goods."

options.label: Bet 15 gold (50%: +40 gold. 50%: lose it).
Ask what is in the graves (a carving, a hero loses 4 HP).

title: A Lost Child
text: A small girl stands in the road, holding a lantern. She asks you to walk her home. She has no shadow.

options.label: Walk her home.

lose.text: Her home is full of teeth.

options.label: Do not look into the lantern. Walk on.

title: The Burning Library
text: Books scream as they burn. One of them is bound in skin and is not burning at all.

options.label: Take the book (carve a die, a hero loses 5 HP).
Save what you can (+20 gold).

title: The Tallow Peddler
text: A hunched man sells candles from a cart. They smell of pork, and of something sweeter. "Light for the road," he says. "Made from those who walked it before you."

options.label: Buy a candle (-15 gold, +3 Fate).
Ask what else is in the cart (a hero loses 4 HP. Choose a weapon).
Walk on, and do not breathe too deeply.

title: The Hollow Well
text: A well with no bottom. Coins glint far below, and a patient voice is counting them.

options.label: Climb down for the coins (+30 gold, a hero loses 6 HP. 30%: something climbs up after you).

win.text: The voice stops counting. Something climbs up after you.

options.label: Throw down 10 gold and make a wish (60%: all heroes heal 8. Otherwise +1 Fate).

title: Pilgrims in Chains
text: A line of pilgrims shuffles along, chained to a cart and singing. Their warden dozes on the driver's bench, a cudgel across his knees.

options.label: Break their chains (fight the warden. Their blessing: +2 Fate).

effects.text: The warden wakes, and he is not alone.

options.label: Pay their toll to the warden (-20 gold). They pray for you: the fallen rise, all heal 4.
Some songs are not yours to stop. Walk on.

title: The Bone Dicer
text: A skeleton sits at a crossroads, throwing knucklebones against itself. It has been losing for a hundred years. It pats the empty seat.

options.label: Play one round (50%: carve a die. 50%: a hero loses 3 max HP).
Steal its dice (+2 Fate, it will not let you leave quietly).

effects.text: The Bone Dicer rises. Its friends were only sleeping.

title: The Ash Mirror
text: A tall mirror stands alone in the road. Your reflection is a little stronger than you, and a little hungrier.

options.label: Trade places for a moment (the healthiest hero gains 4 max HP, all heroes lose 3 HP).
Shatter it (+15 gold, a hero loses 5 HP).

title: The Widow's Forge
text: A cold forge stands by the road. A widow works the bellows, but nothing burns. "Feed it," she says, "and it will make you something."

options.label: Feed it blood (the healthiest hero loses 3 max HP). Choose a weapon.
Feed it gold (-25 gold). Choose a weapon.
Warm your hands at the dead coals and go (all heroes heal 3).

title: The Dry Well
text: A well, its rope still tied. Far below, something glints. Or someone.

options.label: Lower a hero on the rope (a random hero loses 4 HP). Maybe gold.
Leave the well to whatever is at the bottom.

title: The Salt Merchant
text: A merchant sits under a tattered awning, selling salt by the spoonful. "Salt keeps the dead from walking," he says. "Mostly."

options.label: Buy his salt (-20 gold). All heroes heal 8.
Rob him. He is not alone.

effects.text: His bodyguards climb out of the sand.

options.label: Nod and walk on.

title: The Sundial Shrine
text: A shrine to the god who fell. Its sundial casts no shadow at all.

options.label: Bleed on the dial (the lowest hero loses 3 HP). +3 Fate.
Do not pray to a god who fell.

title: The Bone Caravan
text: A caravan stands in the dunes, camels and drivers all bleached to bone. The carts are still loaded.

options.label: Search the carts. Something may still guard them.
Bury them in the sand (+1 Fate, all heroes lose 1 HP).

title: The Mirage Oasis
text: Palm trees, blue water, a woman singing. The jackals will not go near it.

options.label: Drink. It might be real.
Trust the jackals and walk on.

title: The Glassblower
text: An old woman blows glass over a crack in the earth where the fallen sun still burns. "Give me a die," she says. "I will give it back better."

options.label: Give her a drop of blood with it (the healthiest hero loses 4 HP). Carve a die.
Pay her (-30 gold). Carve a die.
Keep your dice.

title: The Buried Knight
text: A gauntlet sticks out of the sand, still gripping a sword. The fingers twitch.

options.label: Pull the sword free.

lose.text: The knight comes up with it.

options.label: Cover the hand with sand and go.

title: The Sandstorm
text: A wall of black sand rolls towards you. There is a half-buried chest in its path.

options.label: Push through and grab the chest (all heroes lose 4 HP, +40 gold).
Shelter behind a dune (the lowest hero loses 2 HP).

title: The Ash Prophet
text: A man buried to his neck in ash calls to you by name. "I have seen how this ends," he says. "Do you want to know?"

options.label: Listen (+2 Fate, a random hero loses 2 max HP).
Dig him out (+15 gold he had in his mouth).
Do not listen.

title: The Thirsting Child
text: A child sits alone on the road with an empty cup. She does not ask. She only holds the cup out.

options.label: Give her your water (all heroes lose 2 HP). The fallen rise, and she smiles.
Walk past. She does not cry.
